say:1:1130983001:1.text: You sneak! Where did you come from?!
say:1:1130983001:1.source_cn: 你……你这家伙？！从哪冒出来的？！
say:1:1130983001:1.male: You sneak! Where did you come from?!
say:1:1130983001:1.female: You sneak! Where did you come from?!

say:2:1130983002:1.text: Don't look at me like that! I haven't done anything... yet...
say:2:1130983002:1.source_cn: 少用这种看坏人的眼神看着我……我可什么都没干！
say:2:1130983002:1.male: Don't look at me like that! I haven't done anything... yet...
say:2:1130983002:1.female: Don't look at me like that! I haven't done anything... yet...

say:5:1130983004:1.text: Can't a guy just take in the scenery of Alkali?
say:5:1130983004:1.source_cn: 我就在这里看看咸水镇的景色，不行吗？
say:5:1130983004:1.male: Can't a guy just take in the scenery of Alkali?
say:5:1130983004:1.female: Can't a guy just take in the scenery of Alkali?

say:6:1130983005:1.text: Just look! All that beautiful, gold... sand, and... all that other stuff too!
say:6:1130983005:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧！多漂亮的风景！金闪闪，黄灿灿的……呃，土地。

choice:3:0:1.text: Did you forget or just not get around to it?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 是没干，还是没来得及干？
choice:3:0:1.male: Did you forget or just not get around to it?
choice:3:0:1.female: Did you forget or just not get around to it?

say:9:1130983007:1.text: ...If you've got the guts, go ahead.
say:9:1130983007:1.male: ...If you've got the guts, go ahead.
say:9:1130983007:1.female: ...If you've got the guts, go ahead.

say:10:1130983008:1.text: We haven't stolen a single coin, so it'd be pointless anyway.
say:10:1130983008:1.source_cn: 反正我们一个金币也没偷，你喊了也没用。
say:10:1130983008:1.male: We haven't stolen a single coin, so it'd be pointless anyway.
say:10:1130983008:1.female: We haven't stolen a single coin, so it'd be pointless anyway.

say:11:1130983009:1.text: Besides, it's normal to lose things in a town like Alkali. My coin pouch has been "misplaced" at least seven or eight times!
say:11:1130983009:1.source_cn: 再说了，咸水镇这地方，丢东西太正常了，我的钱包都被偷过...

choice:3:1:2.text: Well, then I might just have to shout "thief"!
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 那我可要大喊一声“小偷”了！
choice:3:1:2.male: Well, then I might just have to shout "thief"!
choice:3:1:2.female: Well, then I might just have to shout "thief"!
